Title: Vinod's Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 34 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 28 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Shalini - 55 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Anjali stands in the kitchen. Shalini and Vinod stand near her.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Anjali rolls out rotis on the board.]

Anjali: "Hmm, I see."

[Anjali stirs the dal in the pot.]

Anjali: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Vinod stands by the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Vinod: "Anjali, look over here."

[Vinod rides his motorbike to the market.]

Anjali: "What happened?"

[Vinod drives the car to the office.]

Vinod (gently): "What happened?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Shalini: "Vinod, look over here."

[Vinod pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Vinod (gently): "Well done!"

[Vinod sips red wine.]

Vinod: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vinod drinks a beer.]

Shalini: "How beautiful!"

[Vinod staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Vinod: "Yes, all right."

[Vinod and Mother clink their glasses.]

Vinod: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 4: The main road - Day

[Vinod stands on the road. Shalini stands near him.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Shalini (surprised): "Okay, Vinod."

[Vinod's car crashes into a pole.]

Vinod: "Show me too!"

[A dog runs in front of Vinod's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Vinod (gently): "Exactly right."

[Vinod loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Vinod: "I really enjoyed today."
